name: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing with K63-ubiquitin signaling
rationale: All members concern NOD-like receptor recognition of peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide and downstream antibacterial signaling; unlike the GO NOD-regulation confusables, the theme carries the NOD1/2 signaling cascade, K63 ubiquitination and inflammasome receptor members.

name: Motile axoneme assembly and multiciliogenesis
rationale: Members build motile cilia/flagella (dynein arms, central apparatus, sperm axoneme, manchette, mucociliary clearance); unlike sperm-motility, left-right and tubulin-modification confusables, the theme includes multiciliated-cell centriole amplification, basal body organization and transcriptional control of multiciliogenesis.

name: HDL/LDL particle remodeling and phospholipid efflux
rationale: Members cover HDL assembly, HDL and LDL remodeling and ABC-transporter phospholipid efflux; the HDL/LDL remodeling members are absent from all confusables, which centre on cholesterol efflux regulation or intestinal ABC-transporter defects.

qualifier: p75NTR death signaling alongside TRKA survival
name: NGF signaling via p75NTR death and TRKA survival
rationale: Members span NGF processing and p75NTR/dependence-receptor death signaling plus TRKA downstream survival arms (ERK5, CREB, PI3K/AKT, ARMS, FRS2); the p75NTR and dependence-receptor members distinguish it from TRKA-, TRKB/C- and axon-growth confusables.

name: CDX/HNF4-driven intestinal absorptive epithelium identity
rationale: Nearly all members describe the differentiated intestinal epithelium and its hepatocyte-nuclear-factor/CDX lineage programme; CDX-specified intestinal (not hepatic, crypt-stem, Paneth or pancreatic) identity separates it from the confusables, with leukocyte migration an outlier.

name: Glomerular mesangial and endothelial development and filtration
rationale: All members concern the glomerulus (mesangium, glomerular endothelium and vasculature, filtration, albumin handling), whereas the confusables cover ureteric bud, nephric duct and general kidney growth control.

core: Base excision repair lesion recognition and cleavage
name: NEIL glycosylase-initiated base excision repair
rationale: Members cover DNA glycosylase recognition and excision of damaged bases and AP-site processing; NEIL1/NEIL3 defects, NEIL3 crosslink resolution and APEX1-independent single-nucleotide replacement distinguish it from OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 and long-patch gap-filling confusables.

name: Antigen-experienced memory B cell signature
rationale: Members are B-cell and memory B-cell expression modules plus adaptive immune memory; the memory focus distinguishes it from germinal-centre/Tfh/plasma-cell confusables and from the general naive-and-memory B surface signature.

qualifier: both MHC class I and class II pathways
name: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
rationale: Members cover peptide loading and presentation via MHC class I (including cross-presentation and proteasomal processing), class II and class Ib; carrying both arms distinguishes it from confusables restricted to class I/proteasome or to lipid/CD1 and NKT presentation.

name: O-fucosylation of thrombospondin repeat proteins
rationale: All three members concern O-fucose glycosylation of TSR-domain proteins and its B3GALTL defect, unlike the glycosaminoglycan and keratan sulfate biosynthesis confusables.

name: Phosphatidylinositol synthesis and ER-Golgi phospholipid transfer
rationale: Members cover PI synthesis and transfer of PI/PC between ER and Golgi membranes; confusables concern other phospholipid synthesis/remodeling, flippases or Golgi protein prenylation.

name: TP53 regulation and p21-mediated G1 arrest
rationale: Members cover regulation of TP53 expression and cofactor association and TP53 induction of p21-driven G1 arrest, distinct from TP53 apoptotic, G2-arrest and RB/E2F confusables.

qualifier: synthesis, reuptake, catabolism and dopamine receptor signaling
name: Monoamine synthesis, reuptake and dopamine receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover catecholamine/serotonin biosynthesis, vesicular loading, SLC6 reuptake, MAO/COMT degradation and dopamine receptor signaling with drug-response behaviours, distinguishing it from cholinergic, amino-acid transmitter, neuropeptide and addiction-only confusables.

name: Glucose-6-phosphatase transport and glucokinase regulation
rationale: Members concern G6PC/G6PC3 and SLC37A4 hexose-phosphate transport defects plus glucokinase regulation, whereas confusables cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown and gluconeogenesis or fructose metabolism.

name: Atrial and ventricular compact myocardium morphogenesis
rationale: All three members are atrial or ventricular (compact, left) myocardium morphogenesis, unlike confusables on trabeculation, endocardium or second heart field specification.

qualifier: spermatogonial maintenance and sperm chromatin condensation
name: Spermatogonial maintenance and sperm chromatin condensation
rationale: Members cover male germline stem cell maintenance, spermatogonial division, spermatogenesis genes and sperm DNA condensation/protamine exchange, distinguished from piRNA, oocyte, zygotic and imprinting confusables.

qualifier: Golgi glycoprotein, proteoglycan and glycolipid elongation
name: Golgi glycoprotein, proteoglycan and glycolipid glycan biosynthesis
rationale: Members span N-glycan processing, O-glycosylation, glycosaminoglycan/proteoglycan and glycosphingolipid synthesis with nucleotide-sugar transport and their defects; biosynthetic Golgi elongation distinguishes it from lysosomal degradation (MPS) and ER dolichol/GPI confusables.

name: Eye development, phototransduction and retinoid metabolism
rationale: Members cover retina, lens and eye morphogenesis together with phototransduction, the visual retinoid cycle and retinoic acid metabolism; the phototransduction and retinoid members separate it from inner-ear, cilia, placental and gland-development confusables.

qualifier: IRAK1/RIP1 IKK recruitment downstream of TLRs
name: TLR-driven IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kB activation
rationale: Members cover IRAK1-, RIP1- and TICAM1-mediated IKK complex recruitment, TLR7/8/9-IRF7 activation and positive NF-kB regulation, unlike TNFR1, TAK1-induction and noncanonical NF-kB confusables.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial extravasation
rationale: Members cover integrin activation, PECAM1 and heterotypic adhesion, diapedesis and neutrophil/T-cell extravasation, distinguished from integrin-MAPK/Rap1 signaling, immunological synapse and negative adhesion-regulation confusables.

name: Cone opsin light absorption and color vision defects
rationale: All members concern opsins absorbing light and loss of the cone opsins OPN1LW/MW/SW, whereas confusables cover the phototransduction cascade or the retinoid cycle.

qualifier: BMP-driven endothelial specification and outflow-artery morphogenesis
name: BMP signaling in endothelial specification and outflow-artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover arterial/venous/lymphatic endothelial fate, vasculogenesis and BMP/SMAD signaling together with pharyngeal arch, pulmonary, coronary and outflow-tract artery morphogenesis; confusables lack either the endothelial-fate or the outflow-artery components.

qualifier: post-lanosterol sterol and oxysterol bile acid routes
name: Post-lanosterol cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members cover Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell late cholesterol synthesis and bile acid synthesis via 24-/27-hydroxycholesterol (CYP27A1), unlike the mevalonate/lanosterol and CYP-disease confusables.

name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan
rationale: Members cover class A/B/F/H scavenger receptors, apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment, immune complex clearance and hyaluronan degradation; hyaluronan catabolism and efferocytosis distinguish it from oxLDL/amyloid microglial confusables.

name: Podocyte nephrin interactions and cytoskeletal organization
rationale: The three members concern podocyte nephrin interactions, migration and cortical microtubule organization, while confusables are generic actin protrusion, polarity and Rho signaling sets.
